title: Project state panel: four read-only modes over one selection
requirement: The project state panel is one read-only lens over the generated state projections: business requirements, the task board, the design map and tests/traceability share one selection, so picking a requirement filters the other modes; a task shows its requirement and tests, a test shows its requirement and evidence, and a design-map node shows the requirements traced to its component. The map is drawn by the existing designmap renderer and the panel writes nothing.
reason: The proof needs a live DSH web server on a second port, an isolated DSH_HOME and a seeded workspace, plus a real Chromium session; it is not a hermetic test, and the server is torn down after the run. The exact commands, fixture scripts, logs and screenshots are in reports/project-state-panel/ (PROOF.md, proof-panel.mjs, browser-log2.json, state-before.sha, state-after.sha, screens/).
steps: Copy the real state/, designmap/ and docs/analysis/ into /tmp/state-panel-fixture/workspace; do not write state/ in the kit.
Take sha256 of every file under state/ (find state -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum).

Create an isolated DSH_HOME with a copy of profiles/web, install the packed designmap 0.1.21 and project-state-panel 0.1.5 into its node_modules, and start: DSH_HOME=/tmp/state-panel-fixture/home dsh --profile web --patch /tmp/state-panel-fixture/panel-overlay.yml --port 3091 --no-open (cwd /tmp/state-panel-fixture/workspace).
Create a session in that workspace via session/create {request:{cwd}} and open the State panel from the sidebar or the conversation header.
Select REQ-001 in Requirements, switch to Board, open TASK-128, open Links, follow TEST-003, open Overview and read the red/green pair.
Open Tests & trace -> Trace matrix; then Design map, click Analysis record, open Links, follow REQ-080.
Resize to 760x900 and check scrollWidth equals clientWidth; run axe scoped to .ps-root; press Escape and check focus returns to the opener.
Recompute the state/ hashes and compare: they must be identical (the panel wrote nothing).
expected: On a second DSH server pointed at a copy of the real state/ (102 REQ, 223 TASK, 49 TEST): the header shows those counts and index.json v1; selecting REQ-001 yields 1 task and 1 test, the TASK-128 drawer shows REQ-001 and TEST-003, the TEST-003 drawer shows its requirement, the evidence TASK-128 and a recorded RED exit 1 / GREEN exit 0 pair; the map has 9 nodes and 4 nodes traced to requirements, and following Analysis record -> REQ-080 switches to Requirements with the filter set; axe scoped to the panel reports 0 violations; the sha256 of all 483 files under state/ is identical before and after the browser sweep.
